les-circuits-nord-de-madagascar-11jours-.title: Northern Madagascar
les-circuits-nord-de-madagascar-11jours-.summary: Eleven days across the whole north: the red tsingy, Diego Bay, vanilla plantations and the Nosy Be archipelago. Our most complete itinerary.

circuit-nature-traditions-du-nord-8-jour.title: Nature & Traditions of the North
circuit-nature-traditions-du-nord-8-jour.summary: Eight days between nature reserves and Sakalava villages. Meetings with artisans, local markets and homestays.

circuit-sava.title: SAVA Tour
circuit-sava.summary: The vanilla route and Marojejy National Park. A region still untouched by mass tourism, between the Indian Ocean and rainforest.

tours-des-archipels-de-nosy-be.title: Nosy Be Archipelago Tour
tours-des-archipels-de-nosy-be.summary: Four days sailing between Nosy Iranja, Nosy Komba and Nosy Sakatia. Snorkeling, sandbanks and sunsets aboard a traditional dhow.

une-experience-authentique.title: An authentic experience
une-experience-authentique.summary: Three days living at the pace of the villages: fishing at dawn, Sakalava cuisine and a music evening. Far from the tourist trail.

randonnees-immersive-a-nosy-komba.title: Immersive hike on Nosy Komba
randonnees-immersive-a-nosy-komba.summary: Two days of hiking on the island of lemurs, from Ampangorina village to the summit. Homestay and a meeting with local embroiderers.

circuit-2-jours-a-lokobe.title: 2 days in Lokobe
circuit-2-jours-a-lokobe.summary: The island's last primary forest, reached by traditional canoe. Two days to spot brown lemurs, boas and chameleons with a village guide.

meta.title: Excursions in Nosy Be — Full Day and Half Day | Sakalava Tours
meta.description: Nosy Iranja, Tanikely, Lokobe, Mont Passot: our full-day and half-day excursions departing from Nosy Be, led by our local team.

excursions.pageIntro: Outings from half a day to a full day, departing from your hotel: islets, sandbanks, primary forests and fishing villages. Transfer, guide and lunch included.
excursions.viewAria: View the details of the excursion {title}

nosy-iranja.title: Nosy Iranja
nosy-iranja.summary: Two islets linked by a white sandbank that appears at low tide. Fishing village, a climb to the lighthouse and snorkeling in turquoise waters.

nosy-tanikely.title: Nosy Tanikely
nosy-tanikely.summary: The region's best snorkeling spot: corals, tropical fish and turtles just a few meters from shore, within a protected marine reserve.

nosy-komba-nosy-tanikely.title: Nosy Komba & Nosy Tanikely
nosy-komba-nosy-tanikely.summary: The island of lemurs in the morning, the marine reserve in the afternoon. Meet the makis, browse local crafts and go snorkeling, all in one day.

reserve-de-lokobe.title: Lokobe Reserve
reserve-de-lokobe.summary: A crossing by traditional canoe followed by a guided walk through the island's last primary forest. Nocturnal lemurs, chameleons and Madagascar boas.

nosy-sakatia.title: Nosy Sakatia
nosy-sakatia.summary: The island of orchids, a 25-minute boat ride away. Swim with green turtles among the seagrass beds, deserted beaches and a lunch facing the sea.

mont-passot-coucher-de-soleil.title: Mont Passot at sunset
mont-passot-coucher-de-soleil.summary: The island's highest point and its sacred lakes. A 360° panorama over the archipelago as the sun sets over the Mozambique Channel.

mangroves-ambatozavavy.title: Ambatozavavy Mangroves
mangroves-ambatozavavy.summary: A canoe trip along the mangrove channels. Birds, fiddler crabs and a glimpse into daily life in a Sakalava fishing village.

distillerie-ylang-ylang.title: Ylang-ylang distillery
distillerie-ylang-ylang.summary: Nosy Be's fragrant gold: from flower to essential oil. Visit a traditional distillery, the plantations and a stop at the Sacred Tree.

meta.description: Sakalava Tours is a local travel agency based in Nosy Be, founded in 2019. Sakalava guides, small groups, tailor-made tours and excursions in Madagascar.

about.pageIntro: Authentic experiences, attentive service and unforgettable memories at the heart of Madagascar.

values.title: Three principles that guide every trip
values.subtitle: They aren't displayed just to decorate a page: they concretely shape the itineraries we build, the partners we choose, and the ones we turn down.

authenticite.title: Authenticity
authenticite.text: We favor places where local life carries on regardless of visitors passing through. A Sakalava fishing village, a family-run ylang-ylang distillery, a trail only locals walk — rather than a site set up for tour buses.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: Respect for the communities who welcome us, from whom we always ask permission before bringing a group. Respect for natural environments: no contact with turtles or lemurs, no anchoring on coral, no waste left on the islets.

partage.title: Sharing
partage.text: A successful trip is measured by the encounters it made possible. Our guides translate, introduce and explain — and a share of every excursion goes directly to the families and communities who host you.

founder.title: A commitment born from passion
founder.p1: Since 2019, I've been building Sakalava Tours with the wish to share my vision of authentic tourism in Madagascar. As a young enthusiast close to the ground and to local realities, I design every trip as a human, respectful and sincere adventure, full of meaning.
founder.p2: It all began with impromptu outings: I would take passing travelers to places I had known since childhood, places that appeared in no brochure. What struck my first clients most wasn't the scenery — it was being able to sit with a fishing family and understand what was being said around them.
founder.p3: From those outings came a conviction: Nosy Be and northern Madagascar deserve better than the same generic day trip sold everywhere. So I built every tour and excursion myself, scouting the routes on the ground, meeting the families who host travelers, testing tide times and boat crossings before offering them to anyone.
founder.p4: Today, Sakalava Tours remains a human-scale operation, and that's a deliberate choice. We'd rather look after a limited number of travelers properly than fill up boats.
founder.quoteIntro: Our slogan sums up this vision:
founder.quote: Visit the treasures of Madagascar, differently
founder.quoteAfter: Offering an authentic trip, rich in encounters and emotions.
founder.name: The Sakalava Tours team

mission.title: Unforgettable adventures across Madagascar
mission.text: Madagascar opens its doors to a deep, sincere and unforgettable immersion, in step with its smiles, its landscapes and its legends. From the Nosy Be archipelago to the vanilla plantations of the SAVA, through the primary forests of Lokobe and the tsingy of the far north, every itinerary is designed so you go home with more than just photos.

assistance.title: Round-the-clock support
assistance.text: So your stay is a true moment of happiness, we remain reachable day and night to guide, advise and assist you at every step — a delayed flight, changing weather, a last-minute question.

equipe.title: A team that listens
equipe.text: We build a trip that fits you, together. Pace, budget, interests, health or age constraints: every itinerary is discussed before being finalized, and nothing is set in stone once you're there.

local.title: Genuine local knowledge
local.text: Thanks to our thorough knowledge of the ground, we guide you to authentic places and meaningful encounters, far from the classic tourist circuits. Our guides are from the region and speak the local Malagasy dialect.

groupes.title: Genuinely small groups
groupes.text: From 2 to 12 people depending on the outing, never more. That's what allows a village to truly welcome you, everyone to ask their questions, and the site visited not to suffer from your passing through.

guides.question: Are your guides from the region?
guides.answer: Yes. Our guides were born and live in Nosy Be or northern Madagascar. That's what lets us enter a fishing village as expected guests rather than tolerated ones, and translate not just words but context.

langues.question: What languages are the excursions run in?
langues.answer: We guide in French, English, German and Italian. Let us know your language when booking: we always confirm a guide's availability before confirming your outing.

reservation.question: How far in advance should I book?
reservation.answer: For a day excursion, 48 hours is usually enough, sometimes less outside high season. For a multi-day tour, allow two to four weeks: we need to book accommodation and coordinate guides across several stages.

groupes-taille.question: How many people per group?
groupes-taille.answer: From 2 to 12 people depending on the outing, and 2 to 8 for canoe or forest excursions. We never go beyond that, even when demand would allow it.

meilleure-periode.question: What's the best time to visit Nosy Be?
meilleure-periode.answer: From April to November, the dry season offers the best sailing conditions and underwater visibility. From December to March, the rainy season remains suitable for land excursions, with spectacular vegetation and far fewer visitors.

paiement.question: How does payment work?
paiement.answer: A deposit confirms the booking, with the balance paid on-site before the excursion departs. We accept cash in ariary and euros, as well as online payment for the deposit.
